title: Orlando Police Department
key_finding: The City maintains an official Orlando Police Department page describing patrol, investigations, records, and specialized divisions serving Orlando.

title: Contact the Orlando Police Department
key_finding: The City provides official OPD contact channels and headquarters information, confirming an active city police department.

title: Get a Background Check from the Orlando Police Department
key_finding: The City routes background checks and records through Orlando Police Department headquarters, further confirming an active municipal police department.

title: County and Municipal Offense Data 2020
key_finding: FDLE lists Orlando Police Department as a municipal law-enforcement row in the official Florida county-and-municipal offense publication.

title: County and Municipal Offense Data 2019
key_finding: FDLE also lists Orlando Police Department in the prior official county-and-municipal offense publication, supporting municipal continuity.
